_what: MC.priors — the ROLLOUT'S OPPONENT MODEL. Per species, the moves the opponent is assumed to click and with what probability. medicham2-browser.js samples it (`const pr = MC.priors[me.name]`).
_provenance: HAND-AUTHORED. There is no generator for these rows and there never has been. They existed ONLY inside data/engine-data.js, which build/build_engine_data.js read back out of its own previous output — so every check that asked "does the artifact match its sources?" compared these 230 rows to themselves and passed. Relocated here 2026-08-26 so that the comparison has something to compare against. NOT ONE VALUE WAS CHANGED in the move.
_not_derived_from: data/move-priors.json. Measured 2026-08-26: projecting that file through build/medicham-embed.js's own top-6 rule reproduces 0 of these 230 rows and disagrees about the single most likely click on 114 of 230 species. So these are NOT a stale projection of it and regenerating them from it is a decision with a leaf-calibration measurement attached.
_future_work: A generator for these belongs with whoever owns the opponent model (MAG). Changing them changes what every rollout believes the opponent does, so it is not a chore. Until then they are hand-authored and say so.
_rule: Key order is load-bearing: data/engine-data.js is a generated artifact and a reordered key set is a byte change in every engine release that freezes it. Append, do not re-sort.
